name: skillissue
description: Your code failed. The cat knows. The cat is laughing at you.

skillissue.enabled.description: Master switch. When off, SkillIssue never reacts.

skillissue.sound.enabled.description: Play the laughing-cat audio with the reaction.

enumDescriptions: Play through a native OS audio player in the background — no click needed, works even when VS Code is not focused.
Play inside the reaction WebView — may need one click to unlock browser audio.
skillissue.sound.backend.description: How the laughing sound is played.

skillissue.reaction.durationSeconds.description: How long the reaction stays visible, in seconds. Use 0 to keep it until dismissed.

skillissue.reaction.cooldownSeconds.description: Minimum spacing between reactions, in seconds. Use 0 to disable the cooldown.

skillissue.workflows.monitoredKinds.description: Workflow kinds to watch. Leave empty to watch all kinds.

skillissue.workflows.include.description: Only react to operations whose name contains one of these substrings (case-insensitive). Leave empty to include all.

skillissue.workflows.exclude.description: Never react to operations whose name contains one of these substrings (case-insensitive). Excludes win over includes.

skillissue.workflows.treatCancellationAs.description: React when a monitored workflow is cancelled.

skillissue.workflows.treatUnknownAsFailu.description: React when a monitored workflow ends with an unknown result.

skillissue.workflows.detectTerminalComma.description: Also react to build/test/lint commands typed in the integrated terminal, not just tasks. Requires terminal shell integration; ordinary commands (git, ls, grep, …) are ignored.

markdownEnumDescriptions: React to every failure in a streak.
React only to the first failure in a streak; stay quiet until it succeeds again.
skillissue.repeatedFailures.description: How to handle a streak of repeated failures of the same operation.

scripts.pretest: npm run compile && npm run lint
scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:integration
